Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sephiroth triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Repeat.

2060-2744-4247-5660--29.description:

When the creature enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature.

Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
2060-2744-4247-5660--29.notes: This combo will not put infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler unless the creature has mana value 0.

1323-4762-7315.notablePrerequisites: Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
1323-4762-7315.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters onto Devoted Druid.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj's own ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Remove the -1/-1 counter and one of the +1/+1 counters from Experiment Kraj as a state-based action.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 any number of times, resulting in any number of +1/+1 counters on Experiment Kraj.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, add {G}.
Repeat steps 6 and 7 any number of times.
You may also activate Experiment Kraj's own ability any number of times instead of step 7, putting any number of +1/+1 counters onto creatures.

Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.

Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and a Forest, adding {G}{U}.
Play the Forest and Nurturing Peatland from your graveyard.
